title: Ride-booking legalised (Queensland)
summary: From 5 September 2016 ride-booking was legal for drivers with a valid authorisation and safety-inspected vehicle; taxis kept rank-and-hail exclusivity, many taxi and limousine fees were waived, and booking operators had until 1 November 2016 to comply.

instruments.title: Hire Services Amendment Regulation 2016
instruments.provisions: Legalised ride-booking under the Transport Operations (Passenger Transport) framework

direction_rationale: Legalising app-based ride-share removes the legal barrier to entry created by taxi/hire-car licence quotas, adding a new type of supplier and price competition in point-to-point transport.
comparison: States that had not yet legalised ride-sharing (ACT Oct 2015 first, NT Dec 2017/Feb 2018 last)
confounders: taxi licence compensation and per-trip levies
ABN registration by gig drivers inflates business counts
notes: Government cited PwC estimate of $474.1m net economic benefit.
